data.dataset: EMNIST ByClass official train IDX only
data.preprocessing: preprocessing.dataset_images_to_vectors; identical vectors and split for all k
data.split_method: evaluation.split_train_validation applied to the same 500/class reservoir sample

algorithm: Existing ManualKNN, Euclidean distance, existing majority vote and tie-break; each k evaluated independently on the same validation rows.

timings.time_scope: Per-k evaluation_seconds includes repeated ManualKNN Euclidean neighbor search/sorting for all validation vectors and voting; excludes shared data load, preprocessing, split, and macro-F1 aggregation.

historical_comparison.historical_k1000_reported_protocol: 500/class, 620 validation, 30,380 scoring train, seed 42, same shared preprocessing, train IDX only
historical_comparison.reason: The historical k1000 artifact records protocol and scores but no validation source-sample IDs or fingerprint. The new run records IDs/hashes; exact equality cannot be established retroactively.

limitations: Validation is a deterministic holdout derived from official EMNIST train, not official test data.
Timing is local and affected by machine load; each k is run independently so timings include repeated neighbor search.
Selecting among seven k values on this validation set can optimistically bias the winning validation score.
The result says nothing directly about segmentation or external handwriting images.
